algorithm.name: Quality Wins
algorithm.description: Rewards victories based on opponent strength and pre-match expected score. Earns higher credit for defeating stronger opponents.
algorithm.limitations: Cumulative metric rewarding victory volume against strong opponents. Does not penalize losses.

parameters.formula: Sum of (1 - E_win) across eligible wins
parameters.expectedScoreFormula: Glicko-2 E(mu_winner, mu_loser, phi_loser) using pre-match ratings
